name: configTranslate
description: Converts an old Lucee XML configuration (lucee-server.xml or lucee-web.xml.cfm) to the .CFConfig.json format.

params.name: source
params.description: The path to the XML file, the XML itself, or `server` or `web` to use the old XML file in that context's directory.

params.name: target
params.description: The path to write the CFConfig.json file to, or `server` or `web` to write it to that context's directory. When omitted, the result is only returned.

params.name: mode
params.description: Whether the result is for `single` or `multi` mode. Only used when `type` is `server`.

params.name: charset
params.description: The charset used to read the XML file.
